lints.name: rls_enabled_no_policy
lints.title: RLS Enabled No Policy
lints.description: Detects cases where row level security (RLS) has been enabled on a table but no RLS policies have been created.

findings.detail: Table \`private.aka_agent_staff_recovery\` has RLS enabled, but no policies exist

lints.name: security_definer_view
lints.title: Security Definer View
lints.description: Detects views defined with the SECURITY DEFINER property. These views enforce Postgres permissions and row level security policies (RLS) of the view creator, rather than that of the querying user

findings.detail: View \`public.aka_agent_staff_runtime_profile\` is defined with the SECURITY DEFINER property

lints.name: rls_disabled_in_public
lints.title: RLS Disabled in Public
lints.description: Detects cases where row level security (RLS) has not been enabled on tables in schemas exposed to PostgREST

findings.detail: Table \`public.org_staff\` is public, but RLS has not been enabled.

lints.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.

findings.detail: Function `public.aka_agent_recover_staff_credentials(p_secret text, p_fingerprint_hash text)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/aka_agent_recover_staff_credentials`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.aka_agent_staff_client(p_username text, p_password text, p_action text, p_data jsonb)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/aka_agent_staff_client`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
